en.t: After a sudden gastric illness, Byzantine Empress Theodora dies childless, thus ending the Macedonian dynasty
en.s: Theodora Porphyrogenita (Greek: Θεοδώρα Πορφυρογέννητη, romanized: Theodṓra Porphyrogénnētē; c. 980 – 31 August 1056) was the reigning Byzantine Empress from 21 April 1042 to her death on 31 August 1056, and sole ruler from 11 January 1055. She was the last sovereign of the Macedonian dynasty, which had ruled the Byzantine Empire for almost 200 years. Theodora was the youngest daughter of Emperor Constantine VIII.

zh.t: 拜占庭女皇狄奥多拉突发胃病去世，无嗣而终，马其顿王朝由此终结
zh.s: 狄奥多拉·波菲罗革尼塔（希腊语：Θεοδώρα Πορφυρογέννητη；转写：Theodṓra Porphyrogénnētē；约980年—1056年8月31日）是拜占庭女皇，1042年4月21日至去世时在位；自1055年1月11日起独自执政。她是马其顿王朝最后一位君主。该王朝统治拜占庭帝国近200年。狄奥多拉是君士坦丁八世最小的女儿。

en.s: The Angevin invasion of Sicily (1298–1302) was a military campaign launched against the Kingdom of Sicily by an alliance of the Angevin Kingdom of Naples, the Crown of Aragon, and the papacy during the War of the Sicilian Vespers. Fought in the final years of the 20-year long war, the campaign saw the alliance make some territorial gains on the island before ultimately withdrawing in the face of Sicilian resistance.

zh.s: 安茹王朝入侵西西里（1298—1302年）是西西里晚祷战争期间，安茹王朝的那不勒斯王国、阿拉贡王权和教廷结成联盟，对西西里王国发动的一场军事行动。这场战役发生在长达20年的战争末期。联盟一度在岛上取得一些领土，最终面对西西里人的抵抗而撤军。

en.s: The 1420 Caldera earthquake was a pre-Columbian earthquake that shook the southern portion of Atacama Desert in the early morning of 31 August 1420 and caused tsunamis in Chile as well as Hawaii and the towns of Japan. The earthquake is thought to have had a size of 8.8–9.4 Mw. Historical records of the tsunami exist for the Japanese harbours of Kawarago and Aiga where confused residents saw the water recede in the morning of 1 September, without any sign of an earthquake. In Chile, rockfalls occurred along the coast as well, producing blocks of up to 40 tons that are now found inland.

zh.s: 1420年8月31日清晨，前哥伦布时期发生的卡尔德拉地震震动了阿塔卡马沙漠南部，并在智利、夏威夷和日本多地引发海啸。地震震级估计为8.8至9.4级（矩震级）。日本川原郷港和相生港的历史记录显示，居民在9月1日早晨看到海水退去，却没有感受到地震。智利沿海也发生落石，产生最大达40吨的巨石，如今这些石块已出现在内陆。

en.t: King Henry V of England dies of dysentery while in France and his son, Henry VI, becomes king at the age of nine months
en.s: Henry V (16 September 1386 – 31 August 1422), also called Henry of Monmouth, was King of England, Lord of Ireland, and Duke of Aquitaine from 1413 until his death in 1422. His victory at Agincourt in 1415 and his conquest of Normandy gave England the upper hand in the Hundred Years' War and led, by the Treaty of Troyes in 1420, to his recognition as heir and regent of France.

zh.t: 英格兰国王亨利五世在法国死于痢疾，其九个月大的儿子亨利六世继位
zh.s: 亨利五世（1386年9月16日—1422年8月31日），又称蒙茅斯的亨利，自1413年起担任英格兰国王、爱尔兰领主和阿基坦公爵，直至1422年去世。他在1415年阿金库尔战役中获胜，并征服诺曼底，使英格兰在百年战争中占据上风。根据1420年《特鲁瓦条约》，他被承认为法国王位继承人和摄政王。

en.s: The siege of Tartas (31 August 1440 – 24 June 1442) in Gascony was an engagement between English and French forces in the late stages of the Hundred Years' War. It was undertaken by English forces and their Gascon subjects against Charles II of Albret, a powerful nobleman in southwestern France.

zh.s: 塔尔塔围城战（1440年8月31日至1442年6月24日）发生在加斯科涅，是英法两军在百年战争后期的一次交战。英军及其加斯科涅臣属围攻西南法兰西的权贵阿尔布雷的查理二世。

en.t: Under the influence of the Ottoman government, patriarch Symeon I convenes a synod of the Eastern Orthodox Churches in Constantinople which defines the ritual for admitting Catholics to the Eastern Orthodox Churches and condemns the church union of Ferrara-Florence
en.s: Symeon I of Constantinople (Greek: Συμεὼν ὁ Τραπεζούντιος; died autumn 1486) was Ecumenical Patriarch of Constantinople three times: for a short time in 1466, from 1471 to 1475 and from 1482 to 1486. In 1484 he presided over the Synod of Constantinople of 1484 which repudiated the Council of Florence.

zh.t: 在奥斯曼政府影响下，牧首西缅一世在君士坦丁堡召集东正教会主教会议，规定天主教徒加入东正教会的仪式，并谴责费拉拉—佛罗伦萨教会合一
zh.s: 君士坦丁堡牧首西缅一世（希腊语：Συμεὼν ὁ Τραπεζούντιος；卒于1486年秋）曾三次担任君士坦丁堡普世牧首：1466年短暂任职、1471年至1475年任职，以及1482年至1486年任职。1484年，他主持了君士坦丁堡主教会议，该会议否定了佛罗伦萨会议。

en.s: The siege of Klis or Battle of Klis (Croatian: Opsada Klisa, Bitka kod Klisa, Turkish: Klise Kuşatması) was a siege of Klis Fortress in the Kingdom of Croatia within Habsburg monarchy. The siege of the fortress, which lasted for more than two decades, and the final battle near Klis in 1537, were fought as a part of the Ottoman–Habsburg wars between the defending Croatian–Habsburg forces under the leadership of Croatian feudal lord Petar Kružić, and the attacking Ottoman army under the leadership of the Ottoman general Murat-beg Tardić.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 克利斯围城战又称克利斯战役（克罗地亚语：Opsada Klisa、Bitka kod Klisa；土耳其语：Klise Kuşatması），是哈布斯堡王朝统治下的克罗地亚王国境内，对克利斯要塞发起的围攻。这场持续二十多年的围城及1537年克利斯附近的最后一战，均属奥斯曼—哈布斯堡战争的一部分。克罗地亚—哈布斯堡守军由克罗地亚封建领主佩塔尔·克鲁日奇率领，进攻方则是奥斯曼将领穆拉特贝伊·塔尔迪奇率领的奥斯曼军队。

en.s: The Battle of Botkyrka was an incident where an army under Erik XIV and the Pontus De la Gardie, along with the dukes Charles and John met in Botkyrka in 1568 during the ongoing uprising against Erik XIV. It resulted in a victory for Erik, forcing the dukes to retreat.

zh.s: 1568年，埃里克十四世与庞图斯·德拉加迪，以及查理公爵和约翰公爵的军队在博特克尔卡交战。当时正值反抗埃里克十四世的起义期间。埃里克一方获胜，迫使两位公爵撤退。

en.s: The action off Bermuda, also known as Grenville's action off the Bermuda's, was a minor naval engagement that took place off the island of Bermuda over three days in late August 1585 during the Anglo–Spanish War between an English galleass, Tiger, and a larger Spanish galleon, Santa Maria de San Vicente. Tiger was victorious when the Spanish ship surrendered after a severe bombardment.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 百慕大海战又称格伦维尔百慕大海战，是英西战争期间发生在百慕大附近的一场小规模海战，持续三天，时间为1585年8月下旬。英方盖伦桨帆战船“虎号”与规模更大的西班牙大帆船“圣玛丽亚·德·圣维森特号”交战。“虎号”猛烈炮击后，西班牙舰船投降，英方获胜。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Genevadsbro (Swedish: Slaget vid Genevadsbro; Danish: Slaget ved Genevadsbro) also referred to as simply Battle of Genevad was fought between Danish forces besieging Laholm and a Swedish relief force 31 August 1657. The battle ended with a Swedish victory.

zh.s: 耶内瓦兹布罗战役（瑞典语：Slaget vid Genevadsbro；丹麦语：Slaget ved Genevadsbro），也简称耶内瓦德战役，于1657年8月31日进行。丹麦军队当时正在围攻拉霍尔姆，瑞典援军前来交战，最终瑞军获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Molyatichi (Swedish: Malatitze), also known as the Battle of Dobroye, took place on August 31, 1708 at Molyatichi (present-day Belarus near the Russian border) during the Great Northern War. The Russian army of Peter the Great under the command of Mikhail Golitsyn successfully attacked the avatgarde of the Swedish Army of Charles XII under Carl Gustaf Roos. The fighting occurred in the swamp between the rivers Belaya Natopa and Chernaya Natopa. The Swedish forces were surprised by the Russian attack in the morning fog and withdrew to the main Swedish army.

zh.s: 马利亚季奇战役又称多布罗耶战役，于1708年8月31日在马利亚季奇（今白俄罗斯、靠近俄罗斯边境）发生，是大北方战争的一场战斗。米哈伊尔·戈利岑率领彼得大帝的俄军，成功袭击了卡尔十二世麾下由卡尔·古斯塔夫·鲁斯指挥的瑞典军前卫。战斗发生在别拉亚纳托帕河与切尔纳亚纳托帕河之间的沼泽地。瑞军在晨雾中遭到突袭，随后撤回主力部队。

en.s: The Raids on Lochaber and Shiramore (Scottish Gaelic: Bliadhna nan Creach) ("The Year of the Pillaging") took place in the Scottish Highlands between 22 May and 31 August 1746 and were part of the closing operations of the British-Hanoverian Government to bring to an end the Jacobite rising of 1745.

zh.t: 洛哈伯和希拉莫尔袭掠行动
zh.s: 洛哈伯和希拉莫尔袭掠行动（苏格兰盖尔语：Bliadhna nan Creach，意为“劫掠之年”）于1746年5月22日至8月31日在苏格兰高地发生，是英—汉诺威政府结束1745年詹姆斯党起义的收尾行动之一。

en.s: The 1776 New Jersey gubernatorial election was held on August 31, 1776, in order to elect the first Governor of New Jersey. Candidate and former Member of the New York General Assembly William Livingston was elected by the New Jersey General Assembly against his opponent candidate Richard Stockton.

zh.s: 新泽西州于1776年8月31日举行州长选举，选出首任州长。候选人威廉·利文斯顿曾任纽约殖民地议会成员，最终由新泽西州议会选出，击败对手理查德·斯托克顿。

en.s: The siege of Veterani Cave was a military engagement during the Austro-Turkish War of 1788–1791, which took place in August 1788 during the offensive of the Ottoman army of Yusuf Pasha in Banat. After 20 days of resistance, the Habsburg garrison surrendered to the Ottomans.

zh.s: 维泰拉尼洞穴围城战是1788至1791年奥斯曼—哈布斯堡战争期间的一场军事交战，发生在1788年奥斯曼军队优素福帕夏在巴纳特地区发动攻势期间。哈布斯堡守军抵抗20天后向奥斯曼军队投降。

en.t: War of the First Coalition: The British capture Trincomalee (present-day Sri Lanka) from the Dutch in order to keep it out of French hands
en.s: The War of the First Coalition (French: Guerre de la première coalition) was a set of wars between a coalition of several European powers and France fought from 1792 to 1797. The coalition was only loosely allied and fought without much coordination; each power wanted to annex a different part of France should they defeat the French, something that never occurred.

zh.t: 第一次反法同盟战争：英国从荷兰手中夺取亭可马里（今斯里兰卡），以防其落入法国之手
zh.s: 第一次反法同盟战争（法语：Guerre de la première coalition）是1792年至1797年间法国与多个欧洲强国联盟之间的一系列战争。联盟各方联系松散、缺乏协调；每个强国都希望在击败法国后吞并其不同地区，但最终没有一个国家实现这一目标。

en.t: Irish Rebellion: Irish rebels, with French assistance, establish the short-lived Republic of Connacht
en.s: The Irish Rebellion of 1798 (Irish: Éirí Amach 1798; Ulster Scots: "The Turn Out"/"The Hurries") was a popular insurrection against the British Crown in what was then the separate, but subordinate, Kingdom of Ireland. The main organising force was the Society of United Irishmen. First formed in Belfast by Presbyterians opposed to the landed Anglican establishment, the Society, despairing of reform, sought to secure a republic through a revolutionary union with the country's Catholic majority.

zh.t: 爱尔兰起义：在法国协助下，爱尔兰叛军建立短命的康诺特共和国
zh.s: 1798年爱尔兰起义（爱尔兰语：Éirí Amach 1798；阿尔斯特苏格兰语：“The Turn Out”／“The Hurries”）是当时独立但从属于英国王室的爱尔兰王国发生的一场民众起义。主要组织力量是联合爱尔兰人协会。该协会最初由反对土地贵族和圣公会建制派的长老会教徒在贝尔法斯特成立；在改革无望后，协会转而试图通过与该国天主教多数派革命性联合，建立共和国。

en.s: The invasion of the Spice Islands was a military invasion by British forces that took place between February and August 1810 on and around the Dutch owned Maluku Islands (or Moluccas) also known as the Spice Islands in the Dutch East Indies during the Napoleonic Wars. By 1810 the Kingdom of Holland was a vassal of Napoleonic France and Great Britain along with the East India Company sought to control the rich Dutch spice islands in the East Indies.

zh.s: 拿破仑战争期间，英国军队于1810年2月至8月入侵荷属东印度群岛中的马鲁古群岛（又称香料群岛）。到1810年，荷兰王国已成为拿破仑治下法国的附庸；英国与东印度公司希望控制这些富饶的荷兰香料岛屿。

en.s: The Battle of San Marcial was a battle fought during the Peninsular War on 31 August 1813. The Spanish Army of Galicia, led by Manuel Freire, turned back Marshal Nicolas Soult's last major offensive against the army of Britain's Marquess of Wellington.

zh.s: 1813年8月31日，半岛战争期间，曼努埃尔·弗雷雷率领的加利西亚军团击退了尼古拉·苏尔特元帅针对英国威灵顿侯爵军队发动的最后一次大规模攻势。

en.s: The Battle of Caulk's Field was fought during the War of 1812 in Kent County, Maryland, United States, between a small force commanded by Captain Sir Peter Parker of the Royal Navy and American militia forces commanded by Lieutenant Colonel Philip Reed. Parker, who was operating in the Chesapeake Bay region as part of the British campaign against Baltimore, Maryland, landed on the eastern shore of the Chesapeake Bay to move against Reed's militia encampment.

zh.s: 考克斯战场战役发生于1812年战争期间，地点在美国马里兰州肯特县。交战双方是英国皇家海军彼得·帕克爵士上尉率领的一支小部队，以及菲利普·里德中校指挥的美国民兵。帕克当时在切萨皮克湾地区参与英军针对马里兰州巴尔的摩的战役，他在切萨皮克湾东岸登陆，准备进攻里德的民兵营地。

en.s: The capture of the schooner Bravo was a naval battle fought in 1819 between United States Revenue Cutter Service cutters and one of Jean Lafitte's pirate ships. In early 1819, the two U.S. Revenue Cutters USRC Alabama and USRC Louisiana had just been constructed in New York City at a cost of $4,500 each.

zh.s: 捕获“布拉沃号”纵帆船是1819年发生的一场海战，交战双方是美国税务缉私船队的船只和让·拉菲特的一艘海盗船。1819年初，美国税务缉私船“阿拉巴马号”（USRC Alabama）和“路易斯安那号”（USRC Louisiana）刚在纽约建成，每艘造价4,500美元。

en.s: The Battle of Trocadero, fought on 31 August 1823, was the only significant battle in the French invasion of Spain. French forces defeated the Spanish liberal forces and restored the absolute rule of King Ferdinand VII.

zh.s: 特罗卡德罗战役于1823年8月31日进行，是法国入侵西班牙期间唯一一场重要战役。法军击败西班牙自由派军队，恢复了费尔南多七世的绝对统治。

en.s: The Battle of Punta Malpelo was a naval encounter between a Peruvian corvette and two Gran Colombian vessels on 31 August 1828, near the port of Guayaquil, and was the first major combat of the Peruvian Navy as an independent force of the newborn Peruvian nation.

zh.s: 1828年8月31日，秘鲁的一艘轻型护卫舰与大哥伦比亚的两艘船只在瓜亚基尔港附近发生海战。这是秘鲁作为新生独立国家建立海军后首次重要交战。

en.s: The third siege of Callao was a siege that took place in 1838 during the War of the Confederation between the United Restoration Army, supported by the Chilean army and the Peru–Bolivian Confederation. The confederates defeated the restorationist forces, who then retreated to Huacho due to the advance of the confederate army led by Andrés de Santa Cruz.

zh.s: 卡亚俄第三次围城战发生于1838年邦联战争期间，交战双方是智利军队支持的联合复国军与秘鲁—玻利维亚邦联军。邦联军击败复国军；安德烈斯·德·圣克鲁斯率军推进后，复国军撤退至瓦乔。

en.s: The Battle of Jonesborough (August 31 – September 1, 1864) was fought between Union Army forces led by William Tecumseh Sherman and Confederate forces under William J. Hardee during the Atlanta campaign in the American Civil War. On the first day, on orders from Army of Tennessee commander John Bell Hood, Hardee's troops attacked the Federals and were repulsed with heavy losses.

zh.s: 琼斯伯勒战役于1864年8月31日至9月1日在美国内战亚特兰大战役期间进行，交战双方是威廉·特库姆塞·谢尔曼率领的联邦军和威廉·J·哈迪率领的南军。第一天，田纳西军团司令约翰·贝尔·胡德命令哈迪部队进攻联邦军，南军遭到击退并蒙受重大损失。

en.s: Elections to the Reichstag of the North German Confederation were held on 31 August 1867, with run-off elections during the following weeks. The National Liberal Party continued to serve as the largest party, winning 81 seats. These were both the first regular and also the last elections during the North German Confederation. In July 1870 the Reichstag members decided not to hold new elections during the Franco-Prussian War, in spite of the three-year election period.

zh.s: 北德意志邦联于1867年8月31日举行帝国议会选举，随后几周还进行了第二轮投票。国家自由党继续成为最大党，赢得81席。这是北德意志邦联期间首次例行选举，也是最后一次选举。1870年7月，尽管法普战争期间任期尚有三年，帝国议会议员还是决定不举行新一轮选举。

en.s: Abdülhamid II or Abdul Hamid II (Ottoman Turkish: عبد الحميد ثانی, romanized: Abd ul-Hamid-i s̱ānī; Turkish: II. Abdülhamid; 21 September 1842 – 10 February 1918) was the 34th sultan of the Ottoman Empire, from 1876 to 1909, and the last sultan to exert effective control over the fracturing state.

zh.t: 阿卜杜勒·哈米德二世即位
zh.s: 阿卜杜勒·哈米德二世（奥斯曼土耳其语：عبد الحميد ثانی，罗马化：Abd ul-Hamid-i s̱ānī；土耳其语：II. Abdülhamid；1842年9月21日—1918年2月10日）是奥斯曼帝国第34任苏丹，1876年至1909年在位，也是帝国分崩离析前最后一位能有效掌控国家的苏丹。

en.s: The Battle of San Francisco De Malabon (Filipino: Labanan sa San Francisco De Malabon) was the first attack staged by revolutionaries in Cavite at 10 in the morning, August 31, 1896 near Pasong Kalabaw (Now known as Sta. Clara) and the town tribune. The uprising was fought by Magdiwang faction of the Katipunan led by Diego Mojica which signaled the start of the revolution in Cavite.

zh.t: 圣弗朗西斯科-德马拉翁战役
zh.s: 圣弗朗西斯科-德马拉翁战役（菲律宾语：Labanan sa San Francisco De Malabon）于1896年8月31日上午10时在帕松卡拉包附近（今称圣克拉拉）及镇公所一带打响，是卡维特革命者发动的首次袭击。起义军由卡蒂普南马格迪旺派的迭戈·莫希卡率领，这场战斗标志着卡维特革命的开始。

en.s: The Kawit revolt was a short skirmish in the beginning of the revolution in Cavite. Gen. Emilio Aguinaldo, The First President of the Philippines, led some 400 men to the town hall of Kawit, guarded by a few Guardia Civil there. A few days after the revolt, Aguinaldo marched to Imus to meet the enemy in one of the great battles of the revolution.

zh.s: 卡维特起义是卡维特革命初期的一场短暂冲突。菲律宾首任总统埃米利奥·阿吉纳尔多将约400人带到卡维特镇政厅，当时那里由少数西班牙国民警卫队士兵把守。起义发生几天后，阿吉纳尔多率军前往伊穆斯，与敌军交战；那是革命期间一场重要战役。

en.s: The Anglo-Russian Convention of 1907 was a treaty signed between United Kingdom and the Russian Empire on 31 August 1907 in Saint Petersburg. It marked the end of the "Great Game" in Central Asia, where a longstanding rivalry had ensued between the two European colonial empires. The treaty also furthered the Anglo-Russian interest to outflank the German Empire, which was threatening to establish a railroad from Berlin to Baghdad and align with the weakened Ottoman Empire.

zh.s: 1907年英俄协约是英国和俄罗斯帝国于1907年8月31日在圣彼得堡签署的一项条约。它结束了两国在中亚长期争夺影响力的“大博弈”。这项条约也有助于英俄双方制衡德国帝国；德国当时正威胁修建一条从柏林通往巴格达的铁路，并与实力衰弱的奥斯曼帝国结盟。

en.s: The First Battle of Garua took place from 29 to 31 August 1914 during the Kamerun campaign of the First World War between German and invading British forces in northern Kamerun at Garua. It was the first significant action to take place in the campaign and resulted in the German repulsion of the British force.

zh.s: 加鲁阿第一次战役于1914年8月29日至31日第一次世界大战喀麦隆战役期间在北喀麦隆加鲁阿进行，交战双方为德军和入侵的英军。这是该战役中首次重要军事行动，最终英军被德军击退。

en.s: The Battle of Mont Saint-Quentin was a battle on the Western Front during World War I. As part of the Allied Hundred Days Offensive on the Western Front in the late summer of 1918, the Australian Corps crossed the Somme River on the night of 31 August and broke the German lines at Mont Saint-Quentin and Péronne.
en.n: World War I: Start of the Battle of Mont Saint-Quentin, a successful assault by the Australian Corps during the Hundred Days Offensive.

zh.s: 圣康坦山战役是第一次世界大战西线战场的一场战斗。1918年夏末，作为西线盟军百日攻势的一部分，澳大利亚军团于8月31日夜间渡过索姆河，突破了圣康坦山和佩罗讷的德军防线。
zh.n: 第一次世界大战：澳大利亚军团在百日攻势中发起圣康坦山战役，成功实施突击。

en.s: The Battle of Lioma (30–31 August 1918) was fought between the German Empire and British Empire during the East African Campaign of World War I. Having successfully evaded the Allies since late 1917, the German Schutztruppe under Paul von Lettow-Vorbeck waged a guerilla campaign in Portuguese East Africa, attacking and raiding settlements as well as forts in the search of supplies while inflicting as much damage as possible on the Allies.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 利奥马战役于1918年8月30日至31日举行，是第一次世界大战东非战役期间德意志帝国与大英帝国之间的一场战斗。自1917年末成功躲避盟军以来，保罗·冯·莱托-福尔贝克率领的德国殖民地 Schutztruppe 部队在葡属东非展开游击战，袭击和突袭聚居点及堡垒，搜寻补给并尽可能打击盟军。

en.s: The Soviet invasion of Ukraine was a major offensive by the Ukrainian Front of the Red Army against the Ukrainian People's Republic (UPR) during the Soviet–Ukrainian War. The invasion was first planned in November 1918, after the Council of People's Commissars of the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic annulled the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk, and was launched in the first days of January 1919 with the occupation of Kharkiv.

zh.s: 苏联入侵乌克兰是苏俄—乌克兰战争期间，红军乌克兰方面军对乌克兰人民共和国发动的一次大规模攻势。1918年11月，俄罗斯苏维埃联邦社会主义共和国人民委员会废除《布列斯特-立托夫斯克条约》后，首次制定了入侵计划。1919年1月初，红军占领哈尔科夫，行动由此展开。

en.s: The Battle of Komarów, or the Battle of Zamość Ring, was one of the most important engagements of the Polish-Soviet War. It took place between 20 August and 2 September 1920, near the village of Komarowo (now Komarów) near Zamość. It was the last large battle in Europe in which cavalry was used as such and not as mounted infantry.
en.n: Polish–Soviet War: A decisive Polish victory in the Battle of Komarów.

zh.s: 科马鲁夫战役又称扎莫希奇环形战役，是波苏战争中的重要战役之一，于1920年8月20日至9月2日在扎莫希奇附近的科马罗沃村（今科马鲁夫）进行。这是欧洲最后一场把骑兵作为骑兵作战、而非作为骑马步兵使用的大型战役。
zh.n: 波苏战争：波兰在科马鲁夫战役中取得决定性胜利。

en.s: The Soviet intervention in Mongolia was when Soviet troops fought in 1921 at the request of the communist government of the Mongolian People's Party against the anti-communist government of White Russian general Baron Ungern and occupied the entirety of Mongolia. Later there was the establishment of the Mongolian People's Republic, and the formation of modern ideas of Mongolian nationalism, which fully pulled Mongolia out of the influence of the Beiyang government of China and under the influence of Soviet Russia.

zh.s: 1921年，应蒙古人民党共产党政府的请求，苏联军队与反共的白俄将领罗曼·冯·恩琴男爵政权交战，并占领整个蒙古。此后蒙古人民共和国成立，现代蒙古民族主义思想逐渐形成，蒙古也完全脱离中国北洋政府的影响，转而处于苏俄影响之下。

en.s: The Paraná Campaign was the continuation of the São Paulo Revolt of 1924 in western Paraná from 1924 to 1925, concluding with the formation of the Miguel Costa-Prestes Column. Rebel tenentists, led by Isidoro Dias Lopes, withdrew from São Paulo, went down the Paraná River and settled in the region from Guaíra to Foz do Iguaçu, from where they faced the forces of the Brazilian government, commanded by general Cândido Rondon from October 1924.

zh.s: 1924年至1925年，巴拉那战役在巴拉那州西部展开，是1924年圣保罗起义的延续，最终形成米格尔·科斯塔—普雷斯特斯纵队。伊西多罗·迪亚斯·洛佩斯率领的反叛军人派部队撤出圣保罗，沿巴拉那河南下，驻扎在瓜伊拉至伊瓜苏瀑布之间的地区。自1924年10月起，他们在那里与坎迪多·龙东将军指挥的巴西政府军交战。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Andorra on 31 August 1933, the first held under universal male suffrage. The extension of the franchise to all men over 21 followed social unrest referred to as "Andorra's revolution". As political parties were not legalised until 1993, all candidates ran as independents.

zh.s: 安道尔于1933年8月31日举行议会选举，这是该国首次实行成年男性普选。社会动荡（被称为“安道尔革命”）后，投票权扩展至所有21岁以上男性。由于政党直到1993年才合法化，所有候选人均以独立身份参选。

en.s: The Neutrality Acts were a series of acts passed by the US Congress in 1935, 1936, 1937, and 1939 in response to the growing threats and wars that led to World War II. They were spurred by the growth in isolationism and non-interventionism in the US following the US joining World War I, and they sought to ensure that the US would not become entangled again in foreign conflicts.

zh.s: 《中立法案》是美国国会于1935年、1936年、1937年和1939年通过的一系列法案，以应对日益加剧、最终导致第二次世界大战的威胁和战争。这些法案源于美国参加第一次世界大战后日益高涨的孤立主义和不干涉主义，旨在避免美国再次卷入外国冲突。

en.s: The Battle of the Sierra Guadalupe (English: Guadalupe Mountains), also known as the Tagus Campaign, was a continuation of the Nationalist Army's race north toward Madrid in the early stages of the Spanish Civil War. In mid-late August 1936, the three Regulares columns of General Yagüe's Army of Africa dashed through the Sierra de Guadalupe Mountains, also known as Sierra de Villuercas, in central Spain and forded across the Tagus River, capturing several towns and routing the Republicans in a succession of rapid advances.

zh.s: 瓜达卢佩山脉战役又称塔霍河战役，是西班牙内战初期国民军向北进军马德里的延续。1936年8月中下旬，亚盖将军非洲军团的3支正规军纵队迅速穿越西班牙中部的瓜达卢佩山脉（又称比利亚埃尔卡斯山脉），渡过塔霍河，连续快速推进，占领多座城镇并击溃共和军。

en.s: The Gleiwitz incident, or Gliwice incident, was a false flag attack on the radio station Sender Gleiwitz in Gleiwitz (then Germany and now Gliwice, Poland) staged by Nazi Germany on the night of 31 August 1939. Along with some two dozen similar incidents, the attack was manufactured by Germany as a casus belli to justify the invasion of Poland.

zh.s: 格莱维茨事件又称格利维采事件，是纳粹德国于1939年8月31日晚在格莱维茨电台发起的一次假旗行动；当时该地属于德国，今属波兰格利维采。连同约二十起类似事件，德国策划了这次袭击，并将其作为入侵波兰的借口。

en.s: The Lovettsville air disaster occurred on August 31, 1940 near Lovettsville, Virginia. Pennsylvania Central Airlines Trip 19 was a new Douglas DC-3A that was flying through an intense thunderstorm at 6,000 feet (1,800 m). Numerous witnesses reported seeing a large flash of lightning shortly before it nosed over and plunged to earth in an alfalfa field. With limited accident investigation tools at the time, it was at first believed that the most likely cause was the plane flying into windshear, but the Civil Aeronautics Board report concluded that the probable cause was a lightning strike. U.S.

zh.s: 洛夫茨维尔空难于1940年8月31日发生在弗吉尼亚州洛夫茨维尔附近。宾夕法尼亚中央航空19号班机是一架较新的道格拉斯DC-3A客机，当时正以6,000英尺（1,800米）的高度穿越强烈雷暴。多名目击者称，飞机俯冲坠入苜蓿田前不久，他们看到一道强烈闪电。由于当时的事故调查工具有限，起初人们认为最可能的原因是飞机遭遇风切变；但民用航空委员会的报告认定，可能原因是飞机遭到雷击。

en.s: The Battle of Loznica involved an attack on the German garrison of that town by the Jadar Chetnik Detachment on 31 August 1941. Following the World War II German-led Axis invasion of Yugoslavia in April 1941, the Kingdom of Yugoslavia was partitioned. At the time, Loznica was part of the German-occupied territory of Serbia, which included Serbia proper, with the addition of the northern part of Kosovo (around Kosovska Mitrovica), and the Banat. The Chetniks attacked, led by Lieutenant Colonel Veselin Misita, who was killed during the assault. The Germans surrendered, and 93 were captured.

zh.s: 1941年8月31日，亚达尔切特尼克支队袭击了德国驻洛兹尼察守军。1941年4月德国领导的轴心国入侵南斯拉夫后，南斯拉夫王国被瓜分。当时洛兹尼察属于德国占领的塞尔维亚地区，该地区包括塞尔维亚本土、科索沃北部（米特罗维察周边）和巴纳特地区。袭击由韦塞林·米西塔中校率领；他在战斗中阵亡。德国守军投降，93人被俘。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Iran began in September 1941, when Reza Shah was still in power, and were continued during the Anglo-Soviet invasion of Iran and succession of his son Mohammad Reza Pahlavi. Prime Minister Mohammad Ali Foroughi came under great pressures to nullify the election results which were considered devoid of legitimacy.

en.s: The Anglo-Soviet invasion of Iran, also known as the Anglo-Soviet invasion of Persia or the Allied invasion of Iran, was the joint invasion of the officially neutral Imperial State of Iran by the United Kingdom and the Soviet Union in August 1941. The two powers announced that they would stay until six months after the end of the war with their mutual enemy, Nazi Germany (World War II), which turned out to be 2 March 1946.

zh.s: 英苏入侵伊朗，也称英苏入侵波斯或盟军入侵伊朗，是英国和苏联于1941年8月联合入侵当时正式保持中立的伊朗帝国。两国宣布将在与共同敌人纳粹德国的第二次世界大战结束六个月后撤军；最终撤军日期为1946年3月2日。

en.s: Operation Dervish (21–31 August 1941) was the first of the Arctic Convoys of the Second World War by which the Western Allies supplied material to the Soviet Union against Nazi Germany. Included in the convoy was the personnel and equipment of an RAF Wing, for the air defence of the Russian ports, several civilians and diplomatic missions.

zh.s: 德维什行动（1941年8月21日至31日）是第二次世界大战期间北极护航船队的首航。西方盟国通过这些船队向苏联提供物资，帮助其对抗纳粹德国。船队还载有英国皇家空军一个联队的人员和装备，用于保卫俄国港口，以及若干平民和外交使团人员。

en.s: The Soviet evacuation of Tallinn was a Soviet naval evacuation operation carried out from 27 to 31 August 1941 during World War II, the Continuation War, and the German invasion of the Soviet Union. It involved the withdrawal of ships of the Baltic Fleet, units of the Red Army, and Soviet civilians from the encircled Soviet naval base at Tallinn in Soviet-occupied Estonia to Kronstadt, near Leningrad.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，苏联海军于1941年8月27日至31日实施撤离塔林行动。苏联舰队舰船、红军部队和苏联平民从被包围的塔林海军基地（当时位于苏联占领下的爱沙尼亚）撤往列宁格勒附近的喀琅施塔得。该行动发生在继续战争和德国入侵苏联期间。

en.s: The Battle of Isurava, also sometimes referred to as the Battle of Isurava–Abuari or the Battle of Isuraba, took place between 26 and 31 August 1942. Forming part of the Kokoda Track campaign of the Second World War, the battle involved military forces from Australia, supported by the United States, fighting against Japanese troops from Major General Tomitaro Horii's South Seas Detachment, who had landed around Buna and Gona in Papua mid-July 1942, with the intent of capturing Port Moresby to the south, via the overland route.

zh.s: 伊苏拉瓦战役又称伊苏拉瓦—阿布阿里战役或伊苏拉巴战役，于1942年8月26日至31日进行，是第二次世界大战科科达小道战役的一部分。澳大利亚军队在美国支援下与日军交战；日军来自堀井富太郎少将指挥的南海支队。该支队于1942年7月中旬在巴布亚的布纳和戈纳一带登陆，计划从陆路向南攻占莫尔兹比港。

en.t: Bombing of Pisa in World War II
en.s: The bombing of Pisa took place on 31 August 1943, during World War II. Aimed at disabling the city's marshalling yard, it also resulted in heavy damage to the city itself (although its most famous landmarks were left untouched) and civilian casualties.

zh.s: 1943年8月31日，第二次世界大战期间，比萨遭到轰炸。袭击目标是摧毁该市的铁路编组站，但市区也遭到严重破坏，造成平民伤亡；该市最著名的地标则未受损。

en.s: The Liberal Party of Australia is the major conservative and centre-right to right-wing political party in Australia. en.s: Parliamentary elections, which later became infamously the "blue-ballot" elections, were held in Hungary on 31 August 1947. The Hungarian Communist Party, which had lost the previous election, consolidated its power in the interim using salami tactics. This fact, combined with the weakening of the opposition and a revised electoral law, led to further Communist gains. It was Hungary's last remotely competitive election before 1990. In the summer of 1947, in the presence of Soviet arms, Hungary prepared for a new election. The Communists intended to exploit the situation that arose as a result of the disarray of their main rival, the Independent Smallholders Party, to gain a clear majority in the legislature.

zh.s: 匈牙利于1947年8月31日举行议会选举，这场选举后来臭名昭著地被称为“蓝票选举”。匈牙利共产党在上次选举中失利后，利用这段时间通过“香肠战术”巩固权力。反对派力量减弱，加上选举法修订，令共产党进一步扩大优势。这是匈牙利在1990年前最后一次还算有竞争性的选举。1947年夏，在苏联武力驻扎的背景下，匈牙利筹备重新选举。共产党打算利用主要对手独立小农党陷入混乱的局面，在议会中取得明确多数。

en.s: Malaya, officially the Federation of Malaya, was a country in Southeast Asia from 1948 to 1963. It succeeded the Malayan Union and, before that, British Malaya. It comprised eleven states – nine Malay states and two of the Straits Settlements, Penang and Malacca. It was established on the 1st of February 1948.

zh.s: 马来亚，正式名称为马来亚联合邦，是1948年至1963年间位于东南亚的国家。它继承马来亚联邦；在此之前，该地区是英属马来亚。马来亚由11个州组成——9个马来州以及槟城和马六甲两个海峡殖民地。联合邦于1948年2月1日成立。

en.t: A parcel bomb sent by Ngô Đình Nhu (pictured), younger brother and chief adviser of South Vietnamese president Ngô Đình Diệm, failed to kill Norodom Sihanouk, Prime Minister of Cambodia
en.s: Ngô Đình Nhu (; 7 October 1910 – 2 November 1963) was a Vietnamese archivist and politician. He was the younger brother and State Counsellor of South Vietnam's first president, Ngô Đình Diệm. Although he held no formal executive position, he wielded immense unofficial power, exercising personal command of both the ARVN Special Forces (a paramilitary unit which served as the Ngô family's de facto private army) and the Cần Lao political apparatus (also known as the Personalist Labor Party) which served as the regime's de facto secret police.

zh.s: 吴廷瑈（1910年10月7日—1963年11月2日）是越南档案学家和政治家，是南越首任总统吴廷琰的弟弟兼国务顾问。尽管没有正式行政职务，他却掌握巨大的非正式权力，亲自指挥南越陆军特种部队（准军事单位，实际充当吴氏家族的私人军队）和勤劳党政治机器（也称个人主义劳工党，实际充当政权的秘密警察）。

en.t: Trinidad and Tobago gained its independence from the United Kingdom on 31 August 1962
en.s: Trinidad and Tobago, officially the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago, is the southernmost archipelagic country in the Caribbean, comprising the main islands of Trinidad and Tobago, along with several smaller islets. en.t: Start of the Congress of Carrara, one of the major 20th century anarchist congresses
en.s: The Congress of Carrara, held from 31 August to 5 September 1968, in the eponymous city, is one of the major anarchist congresses of the 20th century. Led by anarchist federations from 31 countries—primarily European—the congress aimed to coordinate anarchists on an international scale and founded the International of Anarchist Federations (IAF), one of the main anarchist organizations to this day. 40 delegates and around 120 participants attended the congress, which took place shortly after the Prague Spring and May '68, events marking the rebirth of the anarchist movement.

zh.s: 卡拉拉大会于1968年8月31日至9月5日在同名城市举行，是20世纪重要的无政府主义者大会之一。大会由来自31个国家的无政府主义联合会牵头，参会者以欧洲组织为主，旨在加强国际间无政府主义者的协调，并成立了国际无政府主义联合会（IAF）。大会共有40名代表和约120名参与者出席，时间紧接在布拉格之春和“五月风暴”之后；这两场事件都标志着无政府主义运动复兴。

en.t: Diana, Princess of Wales, her partner, Dodi Fayed, and driver Henri Paul die in a car crash in Paris
en.s: In the early hours of 31 August 1997, Diana, Princess of Wales, died from injuries sustained in a car crash in the Pont de l'Alma tunnel in Paris, France. Dodi Fayed, Diana's partner, and the chauffeur Henri Paul were both found dead inside the car. Diana's bodyguard, Trevor Rees-Jones, was the only survivor of the crash, albeit seriously injured.

en.s: LAPA Flight 3142 was a scheduled Buenos Aires–Córdoba flight operated by the Argentine airline Líneas Aéreas Privadas Argentinas. On 31 August 1999, the Boeing 737-200 operating the flight crashed while attempting to take off from Aeroparque Jorge Newbery International Airport in Buenos Aires. The crash resulted in 65 fatalities – 63 occupants of the aircraft (3 crew members and 60 passengers) and 2 people on the ground – as well as injuries, some serious, to at least 34 people.

zh.s: LAPA 3142号班机是阿根廷私人航空公司运营的一条布宜诺斯艾利斯—科尔多瓦定期航线。1999年8月31日，执行该航班的波音737-200客机在布宜诺斯艾利斯的豪尔赫·纽伯里机场尝试起飞时坠毁。事故造成65人死亡，其中63人为机上人员（3名机组人员和60名乘客），另有2人在地面遇难；至少34人受伤，其中一些伤势严重。

en.t: Donegal v Dublin (2014 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship)
en.s: The Donegal vs Dublin football match that took place on 31 August 2014 at Croke Park in Dublin, Ireland, was the second semi-final match of the 2014 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship. Both teams reached the stage with an undefeated record in the competition. The game was administered by Cavan officials led by Kill Shamrocks referee Joe McQuillan. The result was a shocking loss for the "unbeatable" Dublin - reigning League, Leinster and All-Ireland Champions playing on their own turf. Having been down 0-08 – 0-03 down after 23 minutes, Donegal led 1-08 – 0-10 at half time.

zh.t: 叙利亚西北部攻势（2019年4月至8月）
zh.s: 2019年叙利亚西北部攻势代号为“伊德利卜黎明”（阿拉伯语：فجر إدلب），是叙利亚武装部队及其盟友于2019年4月30日发动的一次军事行动，目标是叙利亚内战期间叙利亚西北部名为“大伊德利卜”的地区内的反叛武装。该地区包括哈马省西北部、伊德利卜省南部和拉塔基亚省东北部。

en.s: The 2019 Prince Edward station attack, also known as the 31 August Prince Edward station incident (Chinese: 831太子站事件), was an incident in which Hong Kong police indiscriminately attacked passengers while arresting protesters who were returning home via Prince Edward station, on the night of 31 August 2019, after a protest was held that same day.

en.t: 2020 Green Party of England and Wales leadership election
en.s: The 2020 Green Party of England and Wales leadership election took place in August 2020 to determine the leader of the Green Party of England and Wales, while an election for the party's deputy leader also took place simultaneously. Jonathan Bartley and Siân Berry, who were elected on a joint ticket in 2018, were re-elected as co-leaders while Amelia Womack was re-elected as the party's deputy leader.

en.s: The 2020 Albanian Supercup was the 27th edition of the Albanian Supercup, an annual Albanian football match. The teams were decided by taking the previous season's Kategoria Superiore champions and the winners of the Albanian Cup. The match was contested by Tirana, champions of the 2019–20 Kategoria Superiore, and Teuta, the 2019–20 Albanian Cup winners.

zh.s: 2020年阿尔巴尼亚超级杯是第27届阿尔巴尼亚超级杯，这项足球赛事每年举行一场，由上赛季阿尔巴尼亚足球超级联赛和阿尔巴尼亚杯冠军交锋。参赛球队是2019—20赛季联赛冠军地拉那队和杯赛冠军特乌塔队。

en.s: An indirect election took place in Estonia on 30 and 31 August 2021 to elect the president of Estonia, who is the country's head of state. The Riigikogu — the Parliament of Estonia — elected Alar Karis to serve in the office and he was sworn in as the 6th president on 11 October 2021.

en.s: Bash in Berlin was a 2024 professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by the American company WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brands, Raw and SmackDown. It took place on August 31, 2024, at the Uber Arena in Berlin, Germany. This was WWE's first PPV and livestreaming event to be held in Germany. Five matches were contested at the event.

en.s: Village council elections were held in Niue on 31 August 2024 to elect members of the village councils of all fourteen villages. However, in only four villages were there more candidates than seats to fill, so all other candidates were elected unopposed. The elections were held alongside four nationwide referendums.

zh.s: 纽埃于2024年8月31日举行村议会选举，为全部14个村的村议会选出成员。只有4个村的候选人数超过席位数，因此其余各村的候选人均自动当选。选举同时举行了4项全国公投。

en.s: On 31 August 2024, a Mil Mi-8 helicopter operating a scheduled charter flight crashed in Kamchatka Krai, Russia, killing all 22 people on board. The aircraft, which was operated by Vityaz-Aero on a sightseeing tour over the Vachkazhets volcano, crashed in poor weather shortly after take-off.

zh.s: 2024年8月31日，一架执行定期包机航班的米-8直升机在俄罗斯堪察加边疆区坠毁，机上22人全部遇难。飞机由维季亚兹-阿耶罗公司运营，原计划在瓦奇卡热茨火山上空观光；起飞后不久，直升机在恶劣天气中坠毁。

en.s: Clash in Paris was a 2025 professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by the American company WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brands, Raw and SmackDown. It took place on August 31, 2025, at the Paris La Défense Arena in Nanterre, France. It marked WWE's second PPV and livestreaming event held in France after Backlash in May 2024, and the first in the Paris metropolitan area.

zh.s: 《巴黎对决》是WWE于2025年制作的一场付费点播及线上直播摔角赛事，参赛选手来自Raw和SmackDown两个主力品牌。赛事于2025年8月31日在法国楠泰尔的巴黎拉德芳斯竞技场举行。这是WWE继2024年5月《Backlash》之后第二次在法国举办付费点播及线上直播赛事，也是首次在巴黎大都会区举办。

en.s: On 31 August 2025, at 23:47 AFT (19:17 UTC), an earthquake with a magnitude of 6.0 on the moment magnitude scale (Mw) struck eastern Afghanistan, near the border with Pakistan. The epicenter of the quake was located in Nurgal District, Kunar Province. It had a hypocenter 8 kilometres (5 miles) beneath the surface, and the shaking had a maximum Modified Mercalli intensity of IX (Violent) in Nurgal.

zh.s: 2025年8月31日阿富汗时间23时47分（协调世界时19时17分），阿富汗东部、靠近巴基斯坦边境地区发生矩震级6.0级地震。震中位于库纳尔省努尔加尔县，震源深度8公里（5英里）。努尔加尔的最高震感达到修订麦加利地震烈度IX度（剧烈）。

en.s: On 31 August 2025, a landslide destroyed the village of Tarasin (also rendered Tarseen and Tarsin) in the Marrah Mountains in Central Darfur, western Sudan, killing between 375 and 1,500 people.
